notes: Microsoft publishes no dimensions, mass or complete control list for this controller on any page found. The Computer History Museum's Xbox record 102662816 is a sealed boxed console set (unusable). The Digital Game Museum's record (digitalgamemuseum.org items/show/419) prints «6.5" x 5.5" x 3"» without axis labels or a statement that the item is unboxed, so it is not filed. Every value is null; the host platform key would be microsoft-xbox.
